newsitem.title: USA: Respironics gets FDA marketing okay.
newsitem.headline: Respironics gets FDA marketing okay.

text.p: Respironics Inc said on Monday that it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its BiPAP S/T-D 30 Ventilatory Support System to treat patients suffering from respiratory insufficiency and respiratory failure.
The company said that the new unit's pressure range enables clinicians to treat patients requiring a higher degree of pressure support.

Additionally, the more advanced model also features an enhanced triggering mechanism, called Auto-Trak Sensitivity, to guide the unit through the inhalation and exhalation cycles of the breathing process.

The BiPAP S/T-D 30 was initially introduced in international markets in the second quarter of fiscal year 1995. Respironics expects to introduce the new model into the U.S. market during the current quarter.
